synopsis: A legendary god-tier game, "Dungeon Job Hunting Recommendation", aka "DanKatsu", features an unprecedented 1,021 playable job classes and over 400 different endings! Overjoyed at the chance to experience it in real life, he immediately enrolls in the Labyrinth Academy—the game's main stage. Armed with his extensive knowledge of the game's mechanics, he aims to obtain the ultimate class: Hero. Not only that, but he also guides his timid childhood friend toward the Alchemist class, allowing the two of them to breeze through the academy's curriculum and rapidly level up! Powerful jobs, legendary loot, and epic rewards—secured at lightning speed! (Source: TO Books, translated)

His only salvation is a newly granted karate skill and his general survival instincts. Luckily, Hitoshi is up for the challenge–he’ll weave clothes out of tree bark, test fruit for poison, and crawl through the mud to test his kicks and punches against goblins and other creatures. No matter how much he levels up in this world, he still longs to find other humans to share his solitude. An engrossing fantasy that pits karate technique against swords and sorcery in another world! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
